title: Email subject and opening line overrides
summary: Super Admins can change an email's subject and opening line in plain text, and reset it to the shipped wording.
changes: Edit the subject and opening line of sign-in, security, reminder, ticket, case, consultation, and Recruitment received emails.
Allow plain text only and only the placeholders the shipped wording already uses.
Record who changed what in the audit log, block stale edits, and reset to the shipped wording in one step.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.42 line: optional wording overrides on top of the existing templates.
validation: Mail, Admin Emails, and auth email tests.
composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: Overrides apply to UK English only, and Recruitment decision emails are not editable.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. The new mail_template_overrides table is left in place and ignored, so emails use the shipped wording.
